Ravi: quick heads-up for release train 25: small policy change and a canary check. Please skim. :wave:
Nora: what's the policy change?
Ravi: Per release ops were updating the quiet-window guidance: any canary p95 regression >200ms for >10m triggers an automatic hold. See policy snippet below.
Deploy Bot: policy-update: release-quiet-window v2 applied by @Ravi
Priya (SRE): Also did a light canary promote at 01:10 UTC; eu-central canary p95 climbed from 110->260ms for a 12m window, likely correlated with a background ingestion job.
Sam: Are we rolling back or holding?
Ravi: Hold applied. Please pause non-essential promotes for train 25. Priya, can you throttle ingestion and validate?
Priya (SRE): throttled ingestion at 01:25 UTC. p95 back to ~130ms at 01:33 UTC. Will monitor 30m.
Nora: I'll mark the train as "hold" on the release board and notify QA to stop parallel schema changes.
Ravi: Action items: Priya watch metrics; Nora update board; Sam stand by for logs if we see repeats. We'll reconvene at +30m or sooner if it flares.
Sam: ack.
Ravi: End. Will post final readout when cleared. :thumbsup:
